subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML/infra)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Hi Emma / Raj —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. High level takeaways: Acme is looking to evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference across mixed GPU fleets, with a pilot around the diagnostic-report generation workflow (models: open-llm family, 8k context). Next step from our side is a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra folks to cover:

- Current model flavors, quantization status, and sequence length distributions
- Throughput/latency SLOs and acceptable tail latencies
- Data paths, PII handling, and network constraints (VPC/on-prem considerations)
- Integration points: SDK/REST, streaming, and caching expectations
- Success metrics for pilot and basic rollout plan

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Apr 19, 10:00-11:30
- Wed Apr 20, 14:00-15:30
- Thu Apr 21, 09:00-10:30

If you prefer, here’s my Calendly: https://calendly.com/dylan-brooks/redwood-technical-deep-dive

I’ve attached a short agenda and a draft scope doc for context. I’ll loop in Marissa (solutions engineer) and Camila (customer reliability lead) to join the call. Please confirm who from your ML/infra team will attend so we can tailor the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Emma Li <emma.li@acmehealth.com>

Hi Dylan —

Thanks — this looks good. Raj and I discussed and the folks we'd like to include are:

- Priya Natarajan (Lead ML Engineer) — priya.n@acmehealth.com
- Vivek Kulkarni (Infra Lead) — vivek.k@acmehealth.com
- Olivia Chen (Security Architect) — olivia.c@acmehealth.com (for the PII/VPC items)

Of the proposed slots, Wed Apr 20 14:00-15:30 PT works best for the team. Please send a calendar invite and any read-ahead we should review.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood can support model quantization to int8 and whether there are recommended profiles for the open-llm variants? If you can include Marissa for the perf/quant discussion that’d be great.

Best,

Thanks — Wed 4/20 14:00 PT is locked. I’ve created the invite and attached the final agenda (redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf) and a draft scope-of-work (scope-of-work-draft.docx) for your review.

Draft agenda (60-90 min):
1) Introductions & goals (5-10 min)
2) ML model landscape & quantization status (15-20 min) — Priya + Marissa
3) Serving architecture & throughput/latency SLOs (20-25 min) — Vivek + Camila
4) Integration/SDK & security considerations (10-15 min) — Olivia + Camila
5) Pilot success criteria and next steps (10 min)

Action items before the meeting:
- Acme: confirm attendee list and share any key perf benchmarks or sample workloads (token lengths, batch sizes)
- Redwood: share read-ahead + proposed hardware mapping; Marissa will prepare quantization/perf notes

If you want us to expand the perf segment to 30-40 min, we can do that — let us know.

—
Dylan Brooks
